meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-07-28 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Deep sleep did the work last night, the autonomics did not. Bedtime slipped to 23:49 — the latest ordinary bedtime of the window — and the night closed at 6h23, 7 minutes under the 6h 30m average. Inside that short window the body went straight for depth: 123 minutes of deep sleep, far above anything else in the seven nights (next best 83m), with awake time held to 13m. REM paid for it at 73m, squeezed by the short window. Score 77, Garmin's 'fair'. The markers are the softer story: HRV fell to 37, the window's lowest and 8 below the 45 average, and RHR ticked up to 55, the window's highest. That is the expected next-morning signature of Monday's 2.2 km pool intervals — 65 min, avg HR 129, max 155, the hardest session of the week — landing on a night that was already short. Stress is still calm at 23. Note the gap in the chart: the Sunday-evening night has no record, so the seven bars run Mon 20 to Mon 27 and skip Sun 26. Readiness is moderate at 66. Hack squat is on today: train it, but hold the load at the last logged 160 kg × 10 rather than adding — the depth response says recovery is being spent, not banked. Tonight, get back under 23:00.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Sinoć je posao odradio duboki san, ali ne i autonomika. Lijeganje je skliznulo na 23:49 — najkasnije redovno lijeganje u prozoru — pa je noć završila na 6h23, 7 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 30m. Unutar tog kratkog prozora tijelo je otišlo ravno u dubinu: 123 minute dubokog sna, daleko iznad svega ostalog u sedam noći (sljedeće najbolje 83m), uz budnost zadržanu na 13m. REM je to platio s 73m, stisnut kratkim prozorom. Ocjena 77, Garminovo 'solidno'. Pokazatelji su mekša priča: HRV je pao na 37, najniže u prozoru i 8 ispod prosjeka od 45, a RHR je porastao na 55, najviše u prozoru. To je očekivani jutarnji potpis ponedjeljkovih bazenskih intervala 2,2 km — 65 min, prosj. puls 129, maks 155, najteži trening tjedna — koji su pali na već kratku noć. Stres je i dalje miran, 23. Primijeti prazninu u grafu: noć s nedjelje navečer nema zapisa, pa sedam stupaca ide od Pon 20 do Pon 27 i preskače Ned 26. Spremnost je umjerena — 66. Hack squat je danas na rasporedu: odradi ga, ali zadrži teret na zadnjih zabilježenih 160 kg × 10 umjesto da dodaješ — reakcija dubokog sna govori da se oporavak troši, a ne štedi. Večeras natrag ispod 23:00.
